output.summary: A fast-growing evergreen shrub or small tree endemic to New Zealand. Its lance-shaped, finely serrated leaves have translucent dots, while its white flowers bear purple spots and are followed by bright red fruit. The berries were occasionally eaten traditionally by Māori, but consumption is not recommended because the plant contains the toxin ngaione.
output.edibilityNote: Berries were occasionally a traditional Māori food, but consumption is not recommended because of the toxin ngaione.
